title: AeroPastel
description: Modpack built around Create Aeronautics, Pastel, and No Man's Land
body:
A feature-rich engineering and exploration pack combining advanced airship mechanics with Pastel's deep magical progression and No Man's Land's breathtaking world overhaul. With over 200 mods, AeroPastel offers a rich, content-packed experience where you can build complex flying contraptions, automate large-scale production lines, explore stunning new landscapes, and uncover countless structures scattered across a completely reimagined world.

<details>
<summary>🛑 WARNING: ALPHA VERSION</summary>

* **Status:** Active testing and development are in progress.
* **Readiness:** The modpack is not yet finished; things may change, be removed, or be added in the future.
* **Issues:** Unstable performance, FPS drops, or sudden crashes may occur.
* **Feedback:** Found a bug or have an idea? Please report them in GitHub Issues.
* **Important:** Not recommended for serious survival worlds. Make sure to back up your saves!

</details>

## No Man's Land – World Generation
The world of AeroPastel is brought to life by No Man's Land, a vanilla-friendly overhaul that transforms the Overworld with great attention to detail. Every biome has been redone – most enhanced, some completely reworked. Discover new biomes like the Maple Forest or the Bog, and find new vegetation for every climate, from Reeds in rivers to Flowerbeds in fields. The world feels more alive with enhanced ambient effects like thicker, environment-dependent fog. From the tallest peaks to the deepest oceanic trenches, through ancient ruins and dense forests, the world's beauty permeates every block. Perfect for those who get immersed in their world to the point of getting lost in it, so infatuated by mystery and discovery.

## Structures & Exploration
A massive collection of structure mods ensures every journey is rewarding:
- YUNG's series – Better Dungeons, Mineshafts, Ocean Monuments, Nether Fortresses, Desert Temples, Jungle Temples, Witch Huts, and End Islands, plus Bridges and Extras
  
- Structory & Towers – atmospheric structures scattered across the world
  
- Moog's structures – Nether, End, and Overworld additions including Soaring and Voyager structures
  
- Integrated Stronghold, Villages, and Dungeons – seamless generation integration
  
- Explorify – adds more points of interest
  
- Towns and Towers – improved villages and watchtowers
  
- Hellish Trials – Nether challenges
  
- Illager Invasion – pillager raids and outposts expanded
  
- Bountiful – reward system for exploration

## Core Features
**Create Aeronautics** – the heart of the pack. Build fully functional airships, planes, and custom moving vehicles with realistic physics. Design modular vessels with working engines, propellers, balloons, and control systems. Take to the skies and explore No Man's Land's stunning world from a completely new perspective.

**Pastel** – a full-feature magic mod centered around the exploration of color as resonance, as natural energy. Embark on a long, expansive journey through the path of the artist. Discover more about the land as you explore – the world grows alongside you, revealing things that were not there before. Pursue the meaning of the rainbow and nature itself. Create new and powerful tools as your newfound comprehension allows you to make yet finer works. Assemble striking machines and contraptions to support your march towards the heart of magic. And once you begin to believe you understand the lands and their essence, descend past the earth's false floor. Descend past the barrier at the foot of the world – the bedrock – and in the final chapter discover a world forgotten, a world left behind. Descend past the veil, and find in the deepest abyss the truth desired. The color itself. Descend, artist, descend...

## Create & Technology
Create Aeronautics is just the beginning. The pack is loaded with Create addons for every playstyle:
- Core – Create, Crafts & Additions, Deco, Encased, Connected, Copycats+, Framed, Interiors
  
- Transport – Big Cannons, Diesel Generators, Propulsion: Simulated, Tracks+, Radars
  
- Production – Ore Excavation, Slice & Dice, Stuff & Additions, Gears n' Kinetics, Power Grid, Power Loader
  
- Magic & Tech – Enchantment Industry, Nuclear, Dragons Plus, CC: Tweaked with Advanced Peripherals, Create: CC Better Recipes
  
- Integration – Compatibility with Rechiseled, Sable, Bits 'n' Bobs, Bells & Whistles

## Pastel Integration & Magic
- Pastel – deep color-based magic progression with a full endgame
  
- Artifacts – powerful equipable items to discover
  
- CC: Tweaked (ComputerCraft) – programmable computers with Advanced Peripherals and Sable integration
  
- Sophisticated Backpacks – upgradable backpacks with massive storage

## Mobs & Creatures
- Alex's Mobs – over 90 new animals and creatures, from alligators and bears to elephants, gorillas, and mythical beasts, each with unique behaviors and interactions
  
- Enderman Overhaul – varied Enderman variants across dimensions
  
- Creeper Overhaul – biome-specific creepers with unique abilities
  
- Guard Villagers – armed villagers who protect their homes
  
- Productive Bees – expanded beekeeping with custom bees and honey products

## Building & Decoration
- Quark – dozens of building blocks and quality-of-life tweaks
  
- Supplementaries – decorative blocks and functional items
  
- Handcrafted – furniture and interior decoration
  
- Design n' Decor – additional building options
  
- Rechiseled – decorative block variants with Create compatibility
  
- Let's Do series – Vinery, Meadow, Beachparty, BloomingNature, HerbalBrews
  
- Upgrade Aquatic – ocean-themed blocks and items
  
- Snow! Real Magic! – dynamic snow accumulation

## Food & Farming
- Farmer's Delight and addons: Slice & Dice, Central Kitchen, Crabber's Delight, Ender's Delight, Miner's Delight, Ocean's Delight, Cultural Delights, Expanded Delight, My Nether's Delight, More Delight

## Quality of Life
- EMI – recipe viewing with EMI Loot, EMI Ores, and EMI integration
  
- Xaero's Minimap & World Map – full mapping system
  
- Jade – tooltip and entity information with addons
  
- Carry On – pick up and move tile entities
  
- Corpse – death inventory management with Curios support
  
- AppleSkin – food and hunger information
  
- Mouse Tweaks – improved inventory management
  
- Traveler's Titles – biome and dimension name display
  
- Better Advancements – improved advancement UI
  
- Polymorph – recipe conflict resolution
  
- Comforts – sleeping bags and hammocks
  
- Gliders – glide through the air
  
- Ok Zoomer – zoom functionality
  
- Presence Footsteps – immersive footstep sounds
  
- Sound Physics Remastered – realistic sound propagation

## Visual & Performance
- Sodium – rendering performance with extras: Dynamic Lights, Leaf Culling, Extra, Reese's Options
  
- Iris – shader support with Flywheel compatibility
  
- Entity Model Features / Entity Texture Features – custom entity visuals
  
- NotEnoughAnimations – smoother player animations
  
- Particle Core & Particle Rain – enhanced particle effects
  
- Alternate Current – optimized redstone
  
- Ferrite Core, ModernFix, Lithium, Krypton – performance optimizations
  
- BadOptimizations, Dynamic FPS, EntityCulling, ImmediatelyFast, Noisium – FPS and server performance
  
- ServerCore – server-side optimization
  
- Clumps – XP orb optimization


### Perfect for players who enjoy:
- Engineering complex mechanical systems with Create and its many addons
  
- Building custom airships and exploring from above with Create Aeronautics
  
- Deep magical progression with Pastel's color-based system
  
- Rich world generation and exploration across No Man's Land's overhauled biomes and countless structures
  
- Creative building with thousands of decorative blocks
  
- A vibrant, living world filled with diverse creatures and mobs
  
- Full tech/magic hybrid progression with ComputerCraft and automation
  
- Smooth performance with extensive optimization mods
